strategyChangelog.evidence: Pool rules and historical results review
exactChanges: Main Pool uses conservative estimated ATS probabilities
Normal early-season exposure cap around 20% of bankroll
No requirement to force 2nd or 3rd wagers
Frozen pool-line value vs current market receives heavy weight
Early games receive an information-loss penalty
Top-10 position is protected unless first place is realistically attainable
Side Pool minimizes expected absolute margin error
Near elimination cuts, survival probability may take priority over pure expected score minimization

mainPool: Must wager at least 100 points each week
Wagers may be any whole number
Total weekly wagers cannot exceed current bankroll
Pool spreads are permanently frozen once posted
Goal for this entry: strong Top 10 probability while pursuing first if realistically within reach
sidePool: Predict outright winner and whole-number winning margin
Correct posted underdog winner receives a 2-point deduction
Exact correct underdog margin may produce a -2 weekly score
Pool spread is permanently frozen once posted
Elimination cuts occur after Weeks 5, 8, 11, 15, and 18
Playoff survivors continue through Super Bowl
